title: 2005 AMC 8 Problem 12
statement: Big Al, the ape, ate \(100\) bananas from May \(1\) through May \(5.\) Each day he ate six more bananas than on the previous day. How many bananas did Big Al eat on May \(5?\)

solutions.text:
Let \(x\) be the number of bananas Big Al ate on May \(3.\) Then Big Al ate the following amounts starting from May \(1:\) \[ x - 12, x - 6, x, x + 6, x + 12. \]

The sum of this is \(5x,\) which equals \(100.\) This gives us that \(x = 20.\) Then on May \(5,\) Big Al ate \(20 + 12 = 32\) bananas.

Thus, D is the correct answer.
hints: The five daily amounts form an arithmetic sequence.
The middle day equals the average of the five days.
